mentions.name: Trialbox
mentions.description: Trialbox is a software trial automation service. Users set it up in a few clicks, provide a docker compose file, and the service automatically spins up and tears down ephemeral VMs each time a signup is triggered on their landing page, letting visitors try the software without manual setup.
mentions.problem: The author needed a very simple, few-clicks service to manage ephemeral trial environments from a docker compose file and couldn't find anything simple, so they decided to build it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a software trial automation infra.

While working on another project, I needed a very simple service I could setup in a few clicks, which would take my docker compose and manage the spin up and tear down of ephemeral VM automatically when triggered by a signup on my landing page.
